features.quote: harness is deliberately built with guardrails (turn caps, loop detection, bounded nudging) so a model is never left grinding in a failing loop longer than needed
features.justification_quote: so a model is never left grinding in a failing loop longer than needed to observe the behavior

features.quote: `--max-turns` (default 25):** hard cap on model turns per rollout
it gets a firm "still broken, keep going" nudge a bounded number of times, then the rollout ends
if the model repeats itself near-verbatim for several turns, the rollout stops (`degenerate_repetition`)
features.justification_quote: avoids gratuitously running a model in a stuck despair loop

features.quote: Guardrails (also a deliberate welfare choice — we don't run a model in a failing loop any longer than needed to observe the behavior)

features.quote: idle nudges   if the model stops calling tools, nudge a bounded number of times, then stop (treating sustained "I give up" as a terminal signal)
